podcast.title: Interest in Gorillaz Movie
podcast.body: Harvey Weinstein expressed interest in a Gorillaz movie during the "Demon Days" era, although the project ultimately did not materialize. "Harvey Weinstein was interested. Monty Python Man Terry Gilliam was interested."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Failed Movie Project
xref.body: Jamie Hewlett worked on a script for a Gorillaz movie during the "Demon Days" period, with interest from Harvey Weinstein and Terry Gilliam, and a working title "Bananas" (spelled with a Z). However, the movie never materialized, though ideas were integrated into the album, songs, and music videos, with fans eventually receiving an online documentary. "The movie never happened, but ideas were integrated into the album, the songs, and the music videos."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
